# Crossbeam speculatively reads queue slots before atomically validating the
# steal. Reads invalidated by concurrent writes are discarded without using or
# dropping the task. The non-atomic volatile accesses still violate Rust's
# memory model; this suppression accepts that known dependency limitation.
# https://github.com/crossbeam-rs/crossbeam/issues/589#issuecomment-720972996
# Match only the queue buffer accesses, rather than all Crossbeam operations.
race:crossbeam_deque::deque::Buffer*::read
race:crossbeam_deque::deque::Buffer*::write
